description: Medium-size conformational-change sample for ring-inversion path exploration.
ui_note: Multiple ring-inversion paths may be possible.

reference_values.note: Approximate chair-to-half-chair conformational barrier; not a curated thermal DeltaG_activation.

notes: Product is generated by inverting the z coordinates of the RDKit/UFF chair conformer.
